hypotheses.expect: Each beat's pulse child on Windows runs windowless (pythonw plus detached_kwargs), even when the loop itself was started under python.exe, so a mis-started loop cannot flash a console every beat.
hypotheses.falsifier: (1) on Windows, with the loop running under python.exe, a beat's pulse child is pythonw.exe and owns no conhost; (2) off Windows the pulse argv is unchanged; (3) the pulse still runs and its result is recorded as before
hypotheses.piece: On nt, heartbeat's pulse spawn uses windowless_spawn.background_pythonw() instead of sys.executable, with the tool's detached kwargs; off nt it is unchanged.
